what.text: This page follows people displaced inside the place IDMC lists under the code XKX, as counted by IDMC.
At the end of 2025, IDMC counted 15533 people living in internal displacement there because of conflict and violence.

why.text: The fact pack records no armed conflict and no dated events for XKX; IDMC counts displacement from conflict and violence.
Mass movements are the disasters recorded for XKX in IDMC's data.

when.text: IDMC's figures stayed between 15533 and 19700 from 2009 to 2025.
The main years of displacement in the data run through the whole period, 2009 to 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say where displaced people are living.
IDMC's new displacements count movements, not people, so someone forced to move twice is counted twice.
